name: Cauliflower Steaks with Kalamata Vinaigrette & White Bean Tomato Salad

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 260°C (500°F). Using a paper towel, lightly coat a sheet pan with oil.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ tsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash cauliflower, cut off leaves, and trim stem. Slice lengthwise into 2 cm steaks.
Place steaks and loose florets on sheet. Rub with oil on each side and season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place in the oven and roast for 15 minutes. Flip and continue roasting until tender and browned, another 5-6 minutes. Then broil for 2-3 minutes to create a golden crust.
Peel and mince garlic. Finely chop olives.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
1 ½ cups Kalamata olives, pitted

instructions.primary_message: In a medium bowl, mix together garlic, olives, lemon juice, oil, and salt. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemon
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 pinches salt

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, prepare salad dressing by whisking together oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ lemon
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse beans; place on paper towels and pat dry. Add to bowl with dressing.
Wash, quarter, and add tomatoes to bowl. Toss salad.
To serve, place cauliflower steaks on a plate, drizzle with vinaigrette, and have with salad on side. Enjoy!
